title: DNA Extraction of Daphnia and Symbionts
author: Pascal Angst
materials: Put sample on On ice for 00:01:00 .
For HMW DNA, carefully invert 50 times.

steps.title: Add sample and lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add the biological sample and 200 µL Cell Lysis Solution (Qiagen Catalog #1045696) to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Grind tissue
steps.instruction: Grind the animals with a clean, DNA‑free plastic pestle that matches the shape of the 1.5 mL tube to maximize maceration.

steps.title: Add additional lysis solution
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL Cell Lysis Solution (Qiagen Catalog #1045696) and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) and invert the tube 25 times.

steps.title: Incubate at 55 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 55 °C while shaking at 400 rpm overnight.

steps.title: Add RNase A on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice, add 20 µL RNase A (20 mg/mL), and invert 25 times.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C while shaking at 400 rpm for 1 hour (01:00:00).

steps.title: Add protein precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL Protein Precipitation Solution (Qiagen Catalog #1045697) and vortex for 15 seconds (00:00:15).

steps.title: Centrifuge mixture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 4 minutes (00:04:00) at 16,000 × g (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Pipette 800 µL–1,000 µL of the supernatant into a new 2 mL tube and discard the remaining tissue.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (800 µL–1,000 µL) of isopropanol to the supernatant and invert the tube 25 times.

steps.title: Centrifuge DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 3 minutes (00:03:00) at 16,000 × g (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Ethanol wash pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 500 µL 70 % ethanol, and invert until the pellet dislodges.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 minute (00:01:00) at 16,000 × g (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Apply SRE purification
steps.instruction: Apply the PacBio SRE Kit (Catalog #102-208-300) for high‑molecular‑weight DNA, then repeat steps 13 and 14 twice for additional purification.

steps.title: Vacuum‑dry sample
steps.instruction: Place the open tube in a vacuum centrifuge for 15 minutes (00:15:00).

steps.title: Hydrate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL DNA Hydration Solution (Qiagen Catalog #1045698) and incubate in the dark overnight. If fewer animals are used, add 20 µL–50 µL instead.

steps.title: Prepare HMW DNA (sample)
steps.instruction: Use snap‑frozen animals; pre‑cool the lysis solution and tube on ice before use.

steps.title: Prepare HMW DNA (grinding)
steps.instruction: Use a cold pestle and move it up and down only 10 times without twisting.

steps.title: Filter HMW lysate
steps.instruction: Pass the lysate through a 70 µm pluriStrainer Mini (Cell Strainer, pluriSelect, catalog 43‑10070‑40).

steps.title: Check pellet tightness
steps.instruction: If the pellet is not tight, place the tube on ice for 5 minutes (00:05:00) and repeat step 9, or pre‑cool the centrifuge to 4 °C.

steps.title: Maximize yield (non‑HMW)
steps.instruction: Use cold isopropanol, add 2 µL glycogen, then freeze the sample for 1 hour (01:00:00).

steps.title: Use cold ethanol
steps.instruction: For maximum yield (non‑HMW), perform the ethanol wash with cold ethanol.
